name: Cold Iron Ring
description: A plain ring that grows colder when its quarry draws near.

name: Ash Compass
description: A scorched brass compass whose needle insists on the nearest marked presence.
boon: Hunt marks last 9 seconds instead of 6.

name: Tallow Candle
description: Its black wick burns steadily, even in the rain beneath the Borough.

name: Salt Pouch
description: A drawstring pouch crusted white along every seam.
boon: Common reagent drops are 50% more frequent.

name: Iron Nail
description: A square-cut spike that has been driven into too many doors.

name: Cracked Hand Mirror
description: A single fracture crosses a mirror that is otherwise perfectly clear.
boon: Reflect 10% of contact damage to the attacker.
source: A Sequence gate boss or the Dark Auction.

name: Ledger of Debts
description: A black-cloth ledger whose clasp has snapped clean through.
curse: Coins gained from enemies are reduced by 20%.
source: A Sequence gate boss or the Dark Auction.

name: Wax Seal Ring
description: A signet bezel cracked around a plug of dark sealing wax.
boon: +8% ability damage after each Sequence gate.
source: A Sequence gate boss or the Dark Auction.

name: Quill of Incident
description: An unfinished sentence can change the course of a fight.
boon: Activate with F: your next three damaging casts deal double damage.
curse: Enemies attack 10% faster for 10 seconds after activation.
source: A Sequence gate boss or a rare elite.

name: Puppeteer's Thread
description: The thread is willing to move a body long after its owner is gone.
boon: A defeated elite fights for you for 20 seconds, once every 90 seconds.
curse: Lose 1% of maximum vitality per second for each such ally.
source: A rare elite at a deep Sequence.

name: Black Cloth Shroud
description: A folded shroud that holds the outline of something missing.
boon: Veilstep also makes nearby enemies bleed a fraction of their vitality.
source: A first-clear gate reward or a rare deep elite.

name: Silent Bell
description: Its sound is never heard, but the borough always listens.
boon: Freeze enemies for three seconds every 120 seconds.
source: A final boss or a very rare elite.
